title: The zodiac
info: The zodiac is a band of constellations along the ecliptic, the path the Sun seems to follow in a year.
That path is really Earth's orbit seen from here. Traditional names include Aries, Leo, and others.
A zodiac picture is a star map. It is not a science test of someone's personality.

options: the Sun's yearly path through the stars
